item.title: Megan Moroney’s Schottenstein Center Setlist: Every Song from Opening Night Of Her ‘Cloud 9’ Tour in Columbus, Ohio
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to "Country Buzz", your go-to podcast for all things country music. I'm your host, and today we're talking about the rising star, Megan Moroney.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: It's been an incredible few years for Megan Moroney. Since releasing her debut album, she's quickly become one of the most popular women in country music, with hits like "Tennessee Orange", "Am I Okay", and "Beautiful Things". And just recently, her third studio album, Cloud 9, debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 all-genre albums chart, making her the first country artist to do so since... well, actually, the first country album by a woman to reach number one on that chart in a long time.
[Music transitions to a short country music clip]
Host: But that's not all - Megan Moroney also received nine nominations for the 2026 Academy of Country Music Awards, the most nominations received by an artist in a single year. And just last Friday night, she kicked off her first arena headlining tour with a sold-out show at the Schottenstein Center in Columbus, Ohio.
[Music transitions back to the soft background music]
Host: The energetic show featured a mix of songs from all her albums, but mostly from Cloud 9. And, as a special treat for her fans, she even threw in a surprise song, "Hair Salon", which has become a fan favorite since it was released on her 2022 EP, Pistol Made of Roses.
[Music transitions to a short clip of "Hair Salon"]
Host: The tour is just getting started, with stops in Indianapolis, Chicago, and Nashville, before heading to Europe. We can't wait to see what's next for this talented country star. That's all for today's episode of "Country Buzz". Thanks for tuning in!
[Outro music fades in]
